newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan March electricity demand down 1.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan March electricity demand down 1.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's electricity demand in March declined on a year-on-year basis for the first time in six months, due to weak heating demand resulting from mild temperatures, an industry body said on Friday.

Demand for electricity supplied by Japan's nine major power utilities in March fell 1.5 percent from the same month a year earlier to 63.3 billion kilowatt hours (kWh), the Federation of Electric Power Companies said.
Household electricity demand fell by 5.4 percent to about 18.9 billion kWh, while commercial electricity demand fell by 0.2 percent to 12.2 billion kWh.

Large-lot industrial demand rose 3.1 percent from the previous year to 22.2 billion kWh, helped by steady growth in demand from major industries such as the steel and chemical sectors, the federation said.
